import json,re,collections
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('analysis')
src=Path('gobreaker.go').read_text().splitlines()
a=json.loads((p/'initial.json').read_text())['findings']
b=json.loads((p/'final.json').read_text())['findings']
assert list(r['id'] for r in a)==list(r['id'] for r in b)
assert all(r['test']=='untested' for r in a)
for r in a+b:
 assert set(r)=={'id','initial','steps','outcome','citation','test','question'}
 c=r['citation']; assert c['fragment']==src[c['line']-1]
checks=json.loads((p/'final-claims.json').read_text())
results=json.loads((p/'final-jev.json').read_text())['checks']
for c in checks:
 assert set(c['citation'])=={'file','line','fragment'} and c['type']=='claim' and c['kind']=='claim'
 assert c['fragment']==src[c['line']-1].strip()
 assert results[c['id']]['statement']==c['statement']
 assert f'**{c["id"]}**' in (p/'review.md').read_text()
print(len(a),len(b),len(checks))
for f in sorted(p.rglob('*')):
 if f.is_file(): print(f,f.stat().st_size)
